summary: Examines how an enterprise can connect to several ISPs over IPv6 with provider-assigned addresses without using network prefix translation. Hosts get an address from each ISP, and source address selection and routing at the site must cooperate. It reviews available mechanisms and their limits.

eli5.summary: If a school has several roads out, each with its own street name, kids must pick the right road for the address on their letter. This explains how.

questions: source address based routing for isps
